subject: Advocate briefing + procurement steps — Finexa pilot
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Kline <jk@finexa.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Aug 2027 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Advocate briefing + procurement steps — Finexa pilot

Jordan — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can align the internal team and arm your champion effectively.

Highlights from demo:
- Generated-search reranker and embeddings flow met the sample latency targets we discussed (~120ms p50 on 8k context).
- Key decision criteria you flagged: accuracy on semantic search, ability to pin model versions for audit, and clear per-token economics.

Stakeholder map (as we understand it):
- Economic buyer: Maya Singh (CPO) — will drive ROI and budget approval.
- Security/Trust: Tom Liu (SecOps) — will validate SOC2, data residency, and KMS requirements.
- Procurement/legal: procurement@finexa.com — handles vendor intake and T&Cs.

Immediate asks for your champion (Jordan):
1) Confirm the stakeholders above (names/emails) and any additional gatekeepers.
2) Please share the procurement vendor form if you have one (or point me to the right contact).
3) Tentative pilot window: you mentioned "end of August" — can we propose Aug 30 start for a 2-week pilot?

What we'll provide to support internal selling (attachments included):
- pilot-scope-ROI.xlsx — modeled ROI by query volume and token usage
- SOC2-summary.pdf — short vendor security summary (high level)
- mutual-action-plan.docx — draft MAP with milestones, success criteria, and rollout steps

Next steps I suggest:
- Jordan confirms stakeholders and procurement contact by EOD Tue.
- Rishi/Stephanie to produce a one-page "Champion Brief" with talk tracks and 3 ROI bullets for execs.
- Procurement kick-off once we receive vendor intake form; we'll provide contract template and standard SOW.

Attaching the draft MAP and ROI workbook for you to share with Maya and Tom. Happy to jump on a 15-min prep with Jordan before an exec readout.

Thanks —
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192
[Attachment: pilot-scope-ROI.xlsx (XLSX)]
[Attachment: SOC2-summary.pdf (PDF)]
[Attachment: mutual-action-plan.docx (DOCX)]

From: Jordan Kline <jk@finexa.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Advocate briefing + procurement steps — Finexa pilot

Rishi — appreciate the clear recap and the materials. Quick confirmations and a couple of asks from our side: 

Confirmed stakeholders:
- Maya Singh, CPO (maya.singh@finexa.com) — economic buyer; wants a concise ROI slide for the exec sync.
- Tom Liu, Head of SecOps (tom.liu@finexa.com) — will assess SOC2 / KMS questions.
- Procurement: procurement@finexa.com (they handle vendor set-up and PO).

Procurement note: I'll loop procurement in once you send the vendor form and contract header. They usually request:
- Vendor W-9 / tax form
- SOC2 Type II report (or interim summary)
- Standard Master Services Agreement (they prefer to start from our template)

Pilot timing: Aug 30 start looks good from our side — I'll confirm Maya's availability for an initial 30-min exec sync the week of Sep 6.

Would be great to get a 1-page champion brief tailored to "why this matters to the CPO" (top 3 metrics: cost-per-query reduction, expected match rate lift, expected time-to-value).

Thanks — I'll share procurement contact details and vendor intake link tomorrow.

Jordan
Director of Product Innovation | Finexa
jk@finexa.com | +1 212-555-0147

From: Finexa Procurement <procurement@finexa.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Jordan Kline <jk@finexa.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2027 11:42:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor intake and contracting info required

Rishi — procurement here. Thanks for the advance info. To start vendor onboarding we need the following items: 

1) Completed vendor intake form (attached)
2) W-9 and tax documentation
3) SOC2 Type II report or vendor summary (SOC2-summary.pdf may suffice for initial review)
4) Primary billing contact and suggested payment terms (Net 30 is default)

Contracting: we typically send our redlines back to the vendor after the initial SOW. If Redwood prefers to start from your MSA, please attach. Otherwise we will circulate ours.

Timeline expectation: if we receive the intake and basic security docs by end of day Thu (Aug 19), procurement can produce a fast-track review and aim to have a PO ready within ~7 business days.

Regards,
Finexa Procurement Team
[Attachment: finexa-vendor-intake-form.pdf (PDF)]

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Kline <jk@finexa.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Aug 2027 07:30:00 -0700
Subject: Champion playbook & talk tracks for Maya (CPO) — draft

Folks — draft one-pager for Jordan and Maya. Below are concise talk tracks and the three ROI bullets Jordan wanted. Please use/trim as needed when arming Jordan for his exec sync.

Champion brief (one page — for Maya):
- Opening line: "Reduce time-to-answer and cut semantic-search costs by consolidating inference onto a single, optimizable serving platform."
- Why now: rising query volume + model sprawl -> 25–40% higher per-query cost across our benchmark customers.

Top 3 ROI bullets (speak in exec terms):
1) Cost: Expected 28% reduction in per-query inference cost in pilot workload (pilot-scope-ROI.xlsx modeling).
2) Quality: 8–12% increase in top-3 retrieval relevance using tuned reranker vs current baseline.
3) Time-to-value: Deploy pilot in 2 weeks with a path to production within 8–10 weeks after success criteria met.

Security & procurement quick answers for Maya/Tom:
- SOC2: We provided a summary (SOC2-summary.pdf); full Type II available on request under NDA.
- Data residency: Optional VPC/private deployment available for regulated workloads; we can restrict logging and KV cache retention per contract.
- Contracting: Redlines are routine — proposed process: we accept procurement template for faster cycle or we can provide our MSA.

Suggested ask for the exec sync:
- "If we can demonstrate the expected cost and relevance uplift in a 2-week pilot, would you sign off to move to a dedicated capacity commit for Q4?"

Attachments to send to Jordan when he briefs Maya: pilot-scope-ROI.xlsx (one-tab summary), SOC2-summary.pdf, mutual-action-plan.docx.

Monica — please confirm the short ROI slide and I'll finalize language. Rishi — I'll join any prep call with Jordan before his exec sync.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Growth Enablement | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: pilot-scope-ROI.xlsx (XLSX)]
